name: LSA-Sequence-TCN-Lite
architecture: Temporal Sequence Classifier (MediaPipe HandLandmarker + Lite BiLSTM)
input: Hand landmarks (2 × 21 × 3) + Selected upper-body pose landmarks (4 points)
output: Algerian Sign Language (LSA) isolated & phrase gloss classes
intendedUse: Assistive communication tool in emergency and healthcare settings with strict human confirmation before transmission.
knownLimitations: Controlled lighting conditions required (avoids strong backlighting)
Signing must remain within camera view frame (no occlusion)
Current MVP models do not parse non-manual facial markers or mouthing
